The source files in this directory are the complete corresponding source for
the unmodified ooz.exe included in release archives.

The release binary is built for Windows x64 with llvm-mingw:

clang++ -O2 -static -std=c++14 -Wno-writable-strings -Wno-format \
  -include sys/stat.h kraken.cpp bitknit.cpp lzna.cpp stdafx.cpp \
  -o ooz.exe
